subject.title: [Bug] Feishu: message(action=send) renders card JSON as plain text instead of interactive card (regression)

question: Should this Feishu proactive-card fix require live Feishu proof before adoption, or should maintainers accept a source/test-based proof override for this credential-gated path?
rationale: The source-level bug and likely fix shape are clear, but multiple candidate PRs closed unmerged because the external Feishu proof gate could not be satisfied by contributors without a live tenant.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until someone provides redacted live output, logs, or a recording showing message(action=send) renders the card instead of raw JSON.

options.title: Apply Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source and focused test coverage as sufficient for this external API path, then adopt or reopen the best candidate branch.

options.title: Defer Until Feishu Owner Picks It Up
options.body: Leave the issue open but do not queue more automation until a Feishu plugin owner can run the live path or sponsor the proof override.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until someone provides redacted live output, logs, or a recording showing message(action=send) renders the card instead of raw JSON.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on both the Feishu proactive send path and the adjacent native-card payload implementation.
